description: This PHP class defines a sample PDF template for account data, including methods to generate an HTML email body with placeholders and translations, and to provide header and footer content for the template.

classes.name: smpl_Account_Sample
classes.description: A class representing a sample PDF template for account information with methods to generate content.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of data this template is associated with, i.e., 'Accounts'.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Returns the main body content of the template as an HTML string with placeholders for account details and localized date.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Returns header content for the template, currently empty.

methods.name: getFooter
methods.description: Returns footer content for the template, currently empty.
